title: epan: Add FT_PROTOCOL PINOs to the layer list
description:
Protocols in Name Only that are registered as FT_PROTOCOL and
highlight their bytes like a protocol should also add their
name to the Protocols in Frame entry like a protocol. PINOs
that are registered as the FT_BYTES type and do not highlight
their bytes should continue not to add their name to the enty.

Note that in some cases FT_PROTOCOL PINOs never actually add
their own item to the tree, and only the parent protocol item
is added. (Others do add their own item.) That means that the
entry added to frames.protocols still will not be filterable.
See #16541. Those PINOs should arguably be dissectors with
[names and] description, an option that was not available when
PINOs were introduced. The behavior of the -d command line option
that mimics Decode As still needs to be updated to use dissector
names instead of protocol names, though, I believe.

Fix #20742, more or less - note that the PINO name of "vxlan_gpe"
is used, instead of adding the parent protocol name, and this
is one of those cases where the `proto_vxlan_gpe` item is never
added, just `proto_vxlan` is added instead. However, this is more
correct. #16541 can probably track all the variants of this, though
it could be split into tasks.
